question_summary: Foreman flagged a conflict between slab-on-deck pour strip reinforcement on Foundation Plan S-101 and #6 dowels at 12" o.c. shown in Structural Detail 3/S502; after PE directed use of the detail, field superintendent asked whether that direction applies to all pour strips on the level or just the one referenced.
deadline_text: Please respond by Thursday, ahead of Friday's pour.
routing_rationale: The conflict involves reinforcement detailing across structural drawings and requires the Structural Engineer of Record to confirm scope of applicability.
